title: Three factors in midlife can delay the onset of dementia by 13 years | New Scientist
description: A study involving 12,000 adults in the US suggests that taking action to prevent dementia during your 50s can make a big difference later in life
author: Carissa Wong

title: Swallowing faecal capsules reduces peanut allergy in six adults | New Scientist
description: Altering the gut microbiomes of people with peanut allergy using faeces donated from an allergy-free individual improved their peanut tolerance in a clinical trial
author: Alice Klein

title: Gene-edited dogs lack the protein that causes allergies | New Scientist
description: A company has created dogs that do not have the main protein that provokes allergies, and hopes to get approval to start selling them
author: Michael Le Page

title: Most-detailed-ever image of sun reveals roiling waves for first time | New Scientist
description: Remarkable images of the sun show vortices on its surface that have never been seen before because they are so small
author: James Woodford

title: Large predators reduce car accidents by keeping deer off roads | New Scientist
description: We already know wolves can make roads safer, and now it's been shown that the presence of cougars reduces deer collisions by 76 per cent
author: Michael Le Page

title: Ancient Egyptians may have built a massive dam near the Red Pyramid | New Scientist
description: Large structures near the Red Pyramid may be the remnants of a major dam, suggesting that the Egyptians used water to help power their construction projects
author: Taylor Mitchell Brown
